description: Look up valid code values for filter fields by searching free-text descriptions. Use the type parameter to select the lookup table: naics (NAICS industry codes), psc (product/service codes), cfda (CFDA/Assistance Listing program numbers), def_code (Disaster/Emergency Funding codes by code, appropriation title, or public law), awarding_agency (agency and sub-agency names, each with its tier and top-tier parent — agency_name and funding_agency_name filters take the matched name; a sub-tier name shared by several parents matches under all parents), recipient (recipient names with UEI/DUNS), or location (US state, county, and congressional district names, resolved to the codes the location filters and usaspending_spending_by_geography shape_codes take). Call this before filtering awards when you know a description but not the exact code. Returns matching codes and names for use in other tool filters.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, at most 500 per call. Agency matches combine independently capped top-tier then sub-tier buckets, preserving their order without deduplicating names; offices are excluded. Location matches combine state, then county, then district rows, and upstream returns at most 100 of each kind. The recipient lookup unions three upstream match buckets (name, UEI, DUNS) and can return up to 3x this value, so its results are capped to this limit before returning — the cap keeps them in bucket order, so name matches fill the page first and identifier matches appear only in whatever room is left. To resolve a specific UEI or DUNS, pass the identifier itself as search_text. Every lookup returns at most limit rows.

search_text.description: Free-text search string. For def_code, use an exact code or part of an appropriation title or public law. For other lookups, use a description, keyword, or partial code.

type.description: Lookup table to search: naics (industry codes), psc (product/service codes, for psc_codes), cfda (Assistance Listing program numbers, for assistance_listings), def_code (Disaster/Emergency Funding codes, for def_codes), awarding_agency (agency and sub-agency names), recipient (recipient names), location (US states with DC and the territories, counties, and current congressional districts, matched from the start of their name: "King County", "Santa Fe", "WA-07"; countries, cities, and ZIP codes are not returned). The psc_codes, assistance_listings, and def_codes filters are taken by usaspending_search_awards and the spending analytics tools.

name: usaspending_autocomplete_filters

cap.description: The limit that was applied, when truncated.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_match`: No codes or names matched the search text; for location, no US state, county, or congressional district did. `api_unavailable`: USAspending.gov API is unreachable or returns an error. `api_timeout`: USAspending.gov did not respond before the request deadline elapsed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitClamp.description: Present when a count input above its per-call cap was reduced to the cap.

applied.description: Value the call used: the per-call cap

notice.description: A reduced limit; how to reach the matches left out when truncated; and that an upstream maximum was reached so more matches may exist — all 500 slots filled at limit 500, or 100 rows of one location kind. Absent when none applies.

items.description: Matched entry — code/name for code lookups, name with tier and top-tier parent for agencies, name plus optional UEI/DUNS for recipients, kind/code/name plus state for locations

abbreviation.description: awarding_agency only: the matched agency's own abbreviation, when it has one

code.description: Code value (NAICS, PSC, Assistance Listing/CFDA, DEF, or location code); use this in filter parameters — an Assistance Listing number goes in assistance_listings and a DEF code in def_codes. A location row's code by kind: state, the 2-letter postal code for a location filter's state and state shape_codes; county, the 5-digit state + county FIPS code for a location filter's county and county shape_codes; district, the 4-digit state FIPS + district number for district shape_codes on usaspending_spending_by_geography. Agency rows carry toptier_code instead.

disaster_group.description: def_code only: USAspending disaster grouping, when supplied

duns.description: DUNS number (legacy) — recipient type only; populated when the search text matches a DUNS

kind.description: location only: what the row names — a US state, DC, or territory; a county; or a current congressional district

name.description: Human-readable name or description; for awarding_agency, the matched agency's own name, which for a sub-agency differs from toptier_name; for location, upstream's uppercase name (WASHINGTON, KING, WA-07)

public_law.description: def_code only: public law for the funding code, when supplied

state.description: location only: the 2-letter postal code of the state a county or district lies in

subtier_code.description: awarding_agency only: the matched sub-tier agency code, when supplied

tier.description: awarding_agency only: toptier for a department-level agency, subtier for a component under one

toptier_code.description: awarding_agency only: the directory top-tier agency code, accepted by usaspending_get_agency

toptier_name.description: awarding_agency only: the top-tier parent name. Use the matched name in agency_name or funding_agency_name on usaspending_search_awards and spending analytics to select the sub-agency; use toptier_name intentionally to select its whole parent department.

uei.description: Unique Entity Identifier (SAM.gov) — recipient type only; populated when the search text matches a UEI

shown.description: Number of results returned, when truncated.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist beyond the limit and were left out. Absent when every match was returned.

title: Autocomplete Codes and Names
